Senior iOS Developer, Freshworks — Apr 2021 - Present
Led feature development for Freshworks' customer engagement mobile suite on iOS. Designed and implemented a modular inbox and notification center using Swift and SwiftUI, reducing screen load times by 30% through view lifecycle and data prefetch optimizations. Built reusable SwiftUI components and coordinated with backend to introduce incremental sync, improving perceived update latency for users by 40%. Drove Xcode project migrations and CI integration, introducing build time caching that cut CI build durations by 25%. Participated in Agile planning, code reviews and mentored junior engineers on iOS best practices and Swift language features.

iOS Developer, Ola — Mar 2019 - Mar 2021
Contributed to Ola's rider and driver iOS apps, owning multiple flow improvements and payment integrations. Implemented secure in-app payment UI modules and optimized mapping view rendering using Swift and Objective-C interop, which decreased UI stutter in navigation by measurable margins during peak usage. Added SwiftUI-based prototype screens for experimental features and maintained large Xcode workspaces with multiple targets. Collaborated closely in Agile squads to ship bi-weekly releases and troubleshoot production issues across Linux-based backend tooling.

Skills: Swift, iOS, SwiftUI, Objective-C, Xcode, Agile, Linux

Education: MBA (Marketing), IIM Indore
